define functions


```{r}
strata_brain_similarity <- function(
  data,                      # Input data frame 
  brain_cols,                # Vector of column names to use for distance calculation
  group_var = "Type_hc_ms",  # Column that defines patient vs control groups
  patient_value = "MS",      # Value in group_var that identifies patients
  control_value = "HC",      # Value in group_var that identifies controls
  strat_var,                 # Stratification variable (REQUIRED - grouping for matching)
  distance_method = "euclidean", # "euclidean", "cosine", or "manhattan"
  plot_title = NULL,        # Plot title (if NULL, will be auto-generated)
  include_counts = TRUE,    # Whether to include subject counts in results
  plot_type = "heatmap"     # "heatmap" or "grid"
) {
  
  # Check if stratification variable is provided
  if (is.null(strat_var)) {
    stop("Stratification variable (strat_var) is required for strata-based matching")
  }
  
  # 1. Split data into patients and controls
  patients <- data[data[[group_var]] == patient_value, ]
  controls <- data[data[[group_var]] == control_value, ]
  
  # Remove rows with NA in any brain columns
  patients <- patients[complete.cases(patients[, brain_cols]), ]
  controls <- controls[complete.cases(controls[, brain_cols]), ]
  
  if (nrow(patients) == 0 || nrow(controls) == 0) {
    stop("No valid data after removing NA values in brain columns")
  }
  
  # 2. Get unique stratification groups
  patient_strata <- unique(patients[[strat_var]])
  control_strata <- unique(controls[[strat_var]])
  
  # Create cross-product of all patient and control strata combinations
  strat_combos <- expand.grid(
    patient_stratum = patient_strata,
    control_stratum = control_strata,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # 3. Calculate mean profiles for each group
  patient_profiles <- list()
  control_profiles <- list()
  
  # Calculate patient group profiles
  for (stratum in patient_strata) {
    subset_data <- patients[patients[[strat_var]] == stratum, ]
    
    # Calculate mean for each brain column
    means <- sapply(brain_cols, function(col) mean(subset_data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE))
    
    # Count subjects in this group
    count <- nrow(subset_data)
    
    patient_profiles[[stratum]] <- list(
      profile = means,
      count = count
    )
  }
  
  # Calculate control group profiles
  for (stratum in control_strata) {
    subset_data <- controls[controls[[strat_var]] == stratum, ]
    
    # Calculate mean for each brain column
    means <- sapply(brain_cols, function(col) mean(subset_data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE))
    
    # Count subjects in this group
    count <- nrow(subset_data)
    
    control_profiles[[stratum]] <- list(
      profile = means,
      count = count
    )
  }
  
  # 4. Calculate distance between profiles
  calculate_distance <- function(v1, v2, method) {
    if (method == "euclidean") {
      return(sqrt(sum((v1 - v2)^2)))
    } else if (method == "cosine") {
      similarity <- sum(v1 * v2) / (sqrt(sum(v1^2)) * sqrt(sum(v2^2)))
      return(1 - similarity) # Convert to distance
    } else if (method == "manhattan") {
      return(sum(abs(v1 - v2)))
    } else {
      stop("Invalid distance method. Choose 'euclidean', 'cosine', or 'manhattan'.")
    }
  }
  
  # 5. Create results dataframe
  results_cols <- c("Patient_Stratum", "Control_Stratum", "Distance", "Similarity")
  
  if (include_counts) {
    results_cols <- c(results_cols, "Patient_Count", "Control_Count")
  }
  
  results <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = length(results_cols), nrow = nrow(strat_combos)))
  colnames(results) <- results_cols
  
  # Fill results with comparison data for all combinations
  for (i in 1:nrow(strat_combos)) {
    p_stratum <- strat_combos$patient_stratum[i]
    c_stratum <- strat_combos$control_stratum[i]
    
    # Calculate distance between mean profiles
    dist_value <- calculate_distance(
      patient_profiles[[p_stratum]]$profile, 
      control_profiles[[c_stratum]]$profile, 
      distance_method
    )
    
    # Fill row in results
    results$Patient_Stratum[i] <- p_stratum
    results$Control_Stratum[i] <- c_stratum
    results$Distance[i] <- dist_value
    results$Similarity[i] <- 1/dist_value
    
    if (include_counts) {
      results$Patient_Count[i] <- patient_profiles[[p_stratum]]$count
      results$Control_Count[i] <- control_profiles[[c_stratum]]$count
    }
  }
  
  # Ensure strata are ordered correctly (if they're numeric or ordered factors)
  if (is.numeric(results$Patient_Stratum) || is.ordered(results$Patient_Stratum)) {
    results$Patient_Stratum <- factor(results$Patient_Stratum, 
                                      levels = sort(unique(results$Patient_Stratum)))
  }
  
  if (is.numeric(results$Control_Stratum) || is.ordered(results$Control_Stratum)) {
    results$Control_Stratum <- factor(results$Control_Stratum, 
                                      levels = sort(unique(results$Control_Stratum)))
  }
  
  # 6. Create visualization
  # Generate plot title if not provided
  if (is.null(plot_title)) {
    cols_str <- paste(brain_cols, collapse = ", ")
    if (nchar(cols_str) > 40) {
      cols_str <- paste0(substr(cols_str, 1, 37), "...")
    }
    
    strat_name <- gsub("_", " ", strat_var)
    plot_title <- paste0("Strata-Based Brain Similarity (by ", strat_name, ")\n",
                         "Using: ", cols_str)
  }
  
  # Create appropriate visualization based on plot_type
  if (plot_type == "heatmap") {
    # Heatmap visualization (similarity between strata)
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(results, ggplot2::aes(x = Patient_Stratum, 
                                            y = Control_Stratum,
                                            fill = Similarity)) +
      ggplot2::geom_tile() +
      ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = round(Similarity, 2)), color = "black", size = 3) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue") +
      ggplot2::labs(title = plot_title,
                    x = paste("Patient", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                    y = paste("Control", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                    fill = paste0("Similarity \n(1/", distance_method, ")")) +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
      ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  } else if (plot_type == "grid") {
    # Grid visualization (points with size for similarity)
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(results, ggplot2::aes(x = Patient_Stratum, 
                                            y = Control_Stratum,
                                            size = Similarity)) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
      ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = round(Similarity, 2)), 
                        vjust = 2, size = 3) +
      ggplot2::labs(title = plot_title,
                    x = paste("Patient", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                    y = paste("Control", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                    size = paste0("Similarity \n(1/", distance_method, ")")) +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
      ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  } else {
    stop("Invalid plot_type. Choose 'heatmap' or 'grid'.")
  }
  
  # Create grid plot (always create it, regardless of which visualization was chosen as main)
  p_grid <- ggplot2::ggplot(results, ggplot2::aes(x = Patient_Stratum, 
                                            y = Control_Stratum,
                                            size = Similarity)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = round(Similarity, 2)), 
                      vjust = 2, size = 3) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = paste0(plot_title, " (Grid View)"),
                  x = paste("Patient", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                  y = paste("Control", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                  size = paste0("Similarity \n(1/", distance_method, ")")) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  # Extract diagonal data (for matching strata)
  matching_strata <- intersect(patient_strata, control_strata)
  diagonal_data <- results[results$Patient_Stratum %in% matching_strata & 
                             results$Control_Stratum %in% matching_strata & 
                             results$Patient_Stratum == results$Control_Stratum, ]
  
  # Return results and plots
  return(list(
    results = results,
    diagonal_data = diagonal_data,
    main_plot = p,
    grid_plot = p_grid
  ))
}

# Use the strata-based function
result <- strata_brain_similarity(
  data = plotting_subset,
  strat_var = "age_group",
  brain_cols = c("NAWM_DVR", "Brain_DVR", "Thalamus_DVR", "Cortical_GM_DVR"),
  distance_method = "euclidean",
  plot_type = "heatmap"  # Primary visualization type
)

# Display plots
print(result$main_plot)  # Heatmap visualization
print(result$grid_plot)  # Grid visualization

# Access diagonal data if needed
print(result$diagonal_data)
```

```{r}
strata_brain_similarity <- function(
  data,                      # Input data frame 
  brain_cols,                # Vector of column names to use for distance calculation
  group_var = "Type_hc_ms",  # Column that defines patient vs control groups
  patient_value = "MS",      # Value in group_var that identifies patients
  control_value = "HC",      # Value in group_var that identifies controls
  strat_var,                 # Stratification variable (REQUIRED - grouping for matching)
  distance_method = "euclidean", # "euclidean", "cosine", or "manhattan"
  plot_title = NULL,        # Plot title (if NULL, will be auto-generated)
  include_counts = TRUE,    # Whether to include subject counts in results
  plot_type = "heatmap"     # "heatmap" or "grid"
) {
  
  # Check if stratification variable is provided
  if (is.null(strat_var)) {
    stop("Stratification variable (strat_var) is required for strata-based matching")
  }
  
  # 1. Split data into patients and controls
  patients <- data[data[[group_var]] == patient_value, ]
  controls <- data[data[[group_var]] == control_value, ]
  
  # Remove rows with NA in any brain columns
  patients <- patients[complete.cases(patients[, brain_cols]), ]
  controls <- controls[complete.cases(controls[, brain_cols]), ]
  
  if (nrow(patients) == 0 || nrow(controls) == 0) {
    stop("No valid data after removing NA values in brain columns")
  }
  
  # 2. Get unique stratification groups and preserve original factor levels
  if (is.factor(data[[strat_var]])) {
    # Store the original levels from the input data
    original_levels <- levels(data[[strat_var]])
    
    # Get unique values but maintain the ordering from original levels
    all_strata <- original_levels[original_levels %in% unique(c(patient_strata, control_strata))]
    patient_strata <- unique(patients[[strat_var]])
    control_strata <- unique(controls[[strat_var]])
  } else {
    # If not a factor, just get unique values
    patient_strata <- unique(patients[[strat_var]])
    control_strata <- unique(controls[[strat_var]])
    all_strata <- unique(c(patient_strata, control_strata))
  }
  # Create cross-product of all patient and control strata combinations
  strat_combos <- expand.grid(
    patient_stratum = patient_strata,
    control_stratum = control_strata,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # 3. Calculate mean profiles for each group
  patient_profiles <- list()
  control_profiles <- list()
  
  # Calculate patient group profiles
  for (stratum in patient_strata) {
    subset_data <- patients[patients[[strat_var]] == stratum, ]
    
    # Calculate mean for each brain column
    means <- sapply(brain_cols, function(col) mean(subset_data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE))
    
    # Count subjects in this group
    count <- nrow(subset_data)
    
    patient_profiles[[stratum]] <- list(
      profile = means,
      count = count
    )
  }
  
  # Calculate control group profiles
  for (stratum in control_strata) {
    subset_data <- controls[controls[[strat_var]] == stratum, ]
    
    # Calculate mean for each brain column
    means <- sapply(brain_cols, function(col) mean(subset_data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE))
    
    # Count subjects in this group
    count <- nrow(subset_data)
    
    control_profiles[[stratum]] <- list(
      profile = means,
      count = count
    )
  }
  
  # 4. Calculate distance between profiles
  calculate_distance <- function(v1, v2, method) {
    if (method == "euclidean") {
      return(sqrt(sum((v1 - v2)^2)))
    } else if (method == "cosine") {
      similarity <- sum(v1 * v2) / (sqrt(sum(v1^2)) * sqrt(sum(v2^2)))
      return(1 - similarity) # Convert to distance
    } else if (method == "manhattan") {
      return(sum(abs(v1 - v2)))
    } else {
      stop("Invalid distance method. Choose 'euclidean', 'cosine', or 'manhattan'.")
    }
  }
  
  # 5. Create results dataframe
  results_cols <- c("Patient_Stratum", "Control_Stratum", "Distance", "Similarity")
  
  if (include_counts) {
    results_cols <- c(results_cols, "Patient_Count", "Control_Count")
  }
  
  results <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = length(results_cols), nrow = nrow(strat_combos)))
  colnames(results) <- results_cols
  
  # Fill results with comparison data for all combinations
  for (i in 1:nrow(strat_combos)) {
    p_stratum <- strat_combos$patient_stratum[i]
    c_stratum <- strat_combos$control_stratum[i]
    
    # Calculate distance between mean profiles
    dist_value <- calculate_distance(
      patient_profiles[[p_stratum]]$profile, 
      control_profiles[[c_stratum]]$profile, 
      distance_method
    )
    
    # Fill row in results
    results$Patient_Stratum[i] <- p_stratum
    results$Control_Stratum[i] <- c_stratum
    results$Distance[i] <- dist_value
    results$Similarity[i] <- 1/dist_value
    
    if (include_counts) {
      results$Patient_Count[i] <- patient_profiles[[p_stratum]]$count
      results$Control_Count[i] <- control_profiles[[c_stratum]]$count
    }
  }
  
  # Ensure strata are ordered according to original factor levels, not alphabetically
  if (is.factor(data[[strat_var]])) {
    # Use the original factor levels from the input data
    original_levels <- levels(data[[strat_var]])
    
    # Filter to only include levels that exist in our results
    stratum_levels <- original_levels[original_levels %in% unique(results$Patient_Stratum)]
    
    # Apply these levels to our results
    results$Patient_Stratum <- factor(results$Patient_Stratum, levels = stratum_levels)
    results$Control_Stratum <- factor(results$Control_Stratum, levels = stratum_levels)
  } else {
    # Fallback to the original numeric/ordered factor handling
    if (is.numeric(results$Patient_Stratum) || is.ordered(results$Patient_Stratum)) {
      results$Patient_Stratum <- factor(results$Patient_Stratum, 
                                      levels = sort(unique(results$Patient_Stratum)))
    }
    
    if (is.numeric(results$Control_Stratum) || is.ordered(results$Control_Stratum)) {
      results$Control_Stratum <- factor(results$Control_Stratum, 
                                      levels = sort(unique(results$Control_Stratum)))
    }
  }
  
  # NEW: Create filtered results with only highest similarity for each patient stratum
  top_matches <- data.frame()
  
  for (p_stratum in unique(results$Patient_Stratum)) {
    # Get all rows for this patient stratum
    p_rows <- results[results$Patient_Stratum == p_stratum, ]
    
    # Find the row with maximum similarity
    max_row <- p_rows[which.max(p_rows$Similarity), ]
    
    # Add to top matches
    top_matches <- rbind(top_matches, max_row)
  }
  
  # 6. Create visualization
  # Generate plot title if not provided
  if (is.null(plot_title)) {
    cols_str <- paste(brain_cols, collapse = ", ")
    if (nchar(cols_str) > 40) {
      cols_str <- paste0(substr(cols_str, 1, 37), "...")
    }
    
    strat_name <- gsub("_", " ", strat_var)
    plot_title <- paste0("Strata-Based Brain Similarity (by ", strat_name, ")\n",
                         "Using: ", cols_str)
  }
  
  # Create appropriate visualization based on plot_type
  if (plot_type == "heatmap") {
    # Ensure proper factor ordering for the plot
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(results, ggplot2::aes(x = Patient_Stratum, 
                                            y = Control_Stratum,
                                            fill = Similarity)) +
      ggplot2::geom_tile() +
      ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = round(Similarity, 2)), color = "black", size = 3) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue") +
      # Force the factor order on the axes
      ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(limits = levels(results$Patient_Stratum)) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(limits = levels(results$Control_Stratum)) +
      ggplot2::labs(title = plot_title,
                    x = paste("Patient", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                    y = paste("Control", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                    fill = paste0("Similarity \n(1/", distance_method, ")")) +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
      ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  } else if (plot_type == "grid") {
    # Grid visualization (points with size for similarity)
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(results, ggplot2::aes(x = Patient_Stratum, 
                                            y = Control_Stratum,
                                            size = Similarity)) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
      ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = round(Similarity, 2)), 
                        vjust = 2, size = 3) +
      # Force the factor order on the axes
      ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(limits = levels(results$Patient_Stratum)) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(limits = levels(results$Control_Stratum)) +
      ggplot2::labs(title = plot_title,
                    x = paste("Patient", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                    y = paste("Control", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                    size = paste0("Similarity \n(1/", distance_method, ")")) +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
      ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  } else {
    stop("Invalid plot_type. Choose 'heatmap' or 'grid'.")
  }
  
  # Create grid plot using only the top matches for each patient stratum
  # First ensure the strata are treated as factors with the right levels
  if (!is.factor(results$Patient_Stratum)) {
    results$Patient_Stratum <- factor(results$Patient_Stratum)
  }
  if (!is.factor(results$Control_Stratum)) {
    results$Control_Stratum <- factor(results$Control_Stratum)
  }
  
  # Create a complete grid of all possible patient and control strata combinations
  all_patient_strata <- levels(factor(results$Patient_Stratum))
  all_control_strata <- levels(factor(results$Control_Stratum))
  
  # Create a complete plot data frame starting with all possible combinations
  # Maintain the factor levels to preserve the original ordering
  plot_data <- expand.grid(
    Patient_Stratum = factor(all_patient_strata, levels = all_patient_strata),
    Control_Stratum = factor(all_control_strata, levels = all_control_strata),
    stringsAsFactors = TRUE
  )
  
  # Add Similarity column (with NA by default)
  plot_data$Similarity <- NA
  
  # Now update only the cells that have top matches
  for (i in 1:nrow(top_matches)) {
    p_strat <- as.character(top_matches$Patient_Stratum[i])
    c_strat <- as.character(top_matches$Control_Stratum[i])
    sim_val <- top_matches$Similarity[i]
    
    # Find the matching row in plot_data and update it
    match_idx <- which(plot_data$Patient_Stratum == p_strat & 
                      plot_data$Control_Stratum == c_strat)
    
    if (length(match_idx) > 0) {
      plot_data$Similarity[match_idx] <- sim_val
    }
  }
  
  # Add other columns from top_matches if needed for the plot
  if (include_counts) {
    plot_data$Patient_Count <- NA
    plot_data$Control_Count <- NA
    
    for (i in 1:nrow(top_matches)) {
      p_strat <- as.character(top_matches$Patient_Stratum[i])
      c_strat <- as.character(top_matches$Control_Stratum[i])
      
      match_idx <- which(plot_data$Patient_Stratum == p_strat & 
                        plot_data$Control_Stratum == c_strat)
      
      if (length(match_idx) > 0) {
        plot_data$Patient_Count[match_idx] <- top_matches$Patient_Count[i]
        plot_data$Control_Count[match_idx] <- top_matches$Control_Count[i]
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Create the plot with the complete data - explicitly set factor levels for the axes
  p_grid <- ggplot2::ggplot(plot_data, ggplot2::aes(x = Patient_Stratum, 
                                           y = Control_Stratum,
                                           size = Similarity)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = ifelse(!is.na(Similarity), 
                                                 round(Similarity, 2), "")), 
                      vjust = 2, size = 3) +
    # Force the factor order on the axes
    ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(limits = levels(factor(plot_data$Patient_Stratum))) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(limits = levels(factor(plot_data$Control_Stratum))) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = paste0(plot_title, " (Best Matches Only)"),
                  x = paste("Patient", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                  y = paste("Control", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                  size = paste0("Similarity \n(1/", distance_method, ")")) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  # Return results and plots
  return(list(
    results = results,
    top_matches = top_matches,  # Filtered results with best matches only
    main_plot = p,
    grid_plot = p_grid
  ))
}

  brain_cols = c("NAWM_DVR", "Brain_DVR", "Thalamus_DVR", "Cortical_GM_DVR"),
  distance_method = "euclidean"
  # plot_type = "heatmap"  # Primary visualization type
)

# Display plots
print(result$main_plot)  # Heatmap visualization
print(result$grid_plot)  # Grid visualization
```

```{r}
      return(sum(abs(v1 - v2)))
    } else {
      stop("Invalid distance method. Choose 'euclidean', 'cosine', or 'manhattan'.")
    }
  }
  
  # 5. Create results dataframe
  results_cols <- c("Patient_Stratum", "Control_Stratum", "Distance", "Similarity")
  
  if (include_counts) {
    results_cols <- c(results_cols, "Patient_Count", "Control_Count")
  }
  
  results <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = length(results_cols), nrow = nrow(strat_combos)))
  colnames(results) <- results_cols
  
  # Fill results with comparison data for all combinations
  for (i in 1:nrow(strat_combos)) {
    p_stratum <- strat_combos$patient_stratum[i]
    c_stratum <- strat_combos$control_stratum[i]
    
    # Calculate distance between mean profiles
    dist_value <- calculate_distance(
      patient_profiles[[p_stratum]]$profile, 
      control_profiles[[c_stratum]]$profile, 
      distance_method
    )
    
    # Fill row in results
    results$Patient_Stratum[i] <- p_stratum
    results$Control_Stratum[i] <- c_stratum
    results$Distance[i] <- dist_value
    results$Similarity[i] <- 1/dist_value
    
    if (include_counts) {
      results$Patient_Count[i] <- patient_profiles[[p_stratum]]$count
      results$Control_Count[i] <- control_profiles[[c_stratum]]$count
    }
  }
  
  # Ensure strata are ordered correctly (if they're numeric or ordered factors)
  if (is.numeric(results$Patient_Stratum) || is.ordered(results$Patient_Stratum)) {
    results$Patient_Stratum <- factor(results$Patient_Stratum, 
                                      levels = sort(unique(results$Patient_Stratum)))
  }
  
  if (is.numeric(results$Control_Stratum) || is.ordered(results$Control_Stratum)) {
    results$Control_Stratum <- factor(results$Control_Stratum, 
                                      levels = sort(unique(results$Control_Stratum)))
  }
  
  # NEW: Create filtered results with only highest similarity for each patient stratum
  top_matches <- data.frame()
  
  for (p_stratum in unique(results$Patient_Stratum)) {
    # Get all rows for this patient stratum
    p_rows <- results[results$Patient_Stratum == p_stratum, ]
    
    # Find the row with maximum similarity
    max_row <- p_rows[which.max(p_rows$Similarity), ]
    
    # Add to top matches
    top_matches <- rbind(top_matches, max_row)
  }
  
  # 6. Create visualization
  # Generate plot title if not provided
  if (is.null(plot_title)) {
    cols_str <- paste(brain_cols, collapse = ", ")
    if (nchar(cols_str) > 40) {
      cols_str <- paste0(substr(cols_str, 1, 37), "...")
    }
    
    strat_name <- gsub("_", " ", strat_var)
    plot_title <- paste0("Strata-Based Brain Similarity (by ", strat_name, ")\n",
                         "Using: ", cols_str)
  }
  
  # Create appropriate visualization based on plot_type
  if (plot_type == "heatmap") {
    # Heatmap visualization (similarity between strata)
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(results, ggplot2::aes(x = Patient_Stratum, 
                                            y = Control_Stratum,
                                            fill = Similarity)) +
      ggplot2::geom_tile() +
      ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = round(Similarity, 2)), color = "black", size = 3) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue") +
      ggplot2::labs(title = plot_title,
                    x = paste("Patient", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                    y = paste("Control", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                    fill = paste0("Similarity \n(1/", distance_method, ")")) +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
      ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  } else if (plot_type == "grid") {
    # Grid visualization (points with size for similarity)
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(results, ggplot2::aes(x = Patient_Stratum, 
                                            y = Control_Stratum,
                                            size = Similarity)) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
      ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = round(Similarity, 2)), 
                        vjust = 2, size = 3) +
      ggplot2::labs(title = plot_title,
                    x = paste("Patient", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                    y = paste("Control", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                    size = paste0("Similarity \n(1/", distance_method, ")")) +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
      ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  } else {
    stop("Invalid plot_type. Choose 'heatmap' or 'grid'.")
  }
  
  # Create grid plot using only the top matches for each patient stratum
  # First ensure the strata are treated as factors with the right levels
  if (!is.factor(results$Patient_Stratum)) {
    results$Patient_Stratum <- factor(results$Patient_Stratum)
  }
  if (!is.factor(results$Control_Stratum)) {
    results$Control_Stratum <- factor(results$Control_Stratum)
  }
  
  # Create a grid with all strata combinations
  all_patient_strata <- levels(factor(results$Patient_Stratum))
  all_control_strata <- levels(factor(results$Control_Stratum))
  
  # Create a complete plot data frame starting with all possible combinations
  plot_data <- expand.grid(
    Patient_Stratum = all_patient_strata,
    Control_Stratum = all_control_strata,
    stringsAsFactors = TRUE
  )
  
  # Add Similarity column (with NA by default)
  plot_data$Similarity <- NA
  
  # Now update only the cells that have top matches
  for (i in 1:nrow(top_matches)) {
    p_strat <- as.character(top_matches$Patient_Stratum[i])
    c_strat <- as.character(top_matches$Control_Stratum[i])
    sim_val <- top_matches$Similarity[i]
    
    # Find the matching row in plot_data and update it
    match_idx <- which(plot_data$Patient_Stratum == p_strat & 
                      plot_data$Control_Stratum == c_strat)
    
    if (length(match_idx) > 0) {
      plot_data$Similarity[match_idx] <- sim_val
    }
  }
  
  # Add other columns from top_matches if needed for the plot
  if (include_counts) {
    plot_data$Patient_Count <- NA
    plot_data$Control_Count <- NA
    
    for (i in 1:nrow(top_matches)) {
      p_strat <- as.character(top_matches$Patient_Stratum[i])
      c_strat <- as.character(top_matches$Control_Stratum[i])
      
      match_idx <- which(plot_data$Patient_Stratum == p_strat & 
                        plot_data$Control_Stratum == c_strat)
      
      if (length(match_idx) > 0) {
        plot_data$Patient_Count[match_idx] <- top_matches$Patient_Count[i]
        plot_data$Control_Count[match_idx] <- top_matches$Control_Count[i]
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Create the plot with the complete data
  p_grid <- ggplot2::ggplot(plot_data, ggplot2::aes(x = Patient_Stratum, 
                                           y = Control_Stratum,
                                           size = Similarity)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +  # Use na.rm to handle NAs in Similarity
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = ifelse(!is.na(Similarity), 
                                                 round(Similarity, 2), "")), 
                      vjust = 2, size = 3) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = paste0(plot_title, " (Best Matches Only)"),
                  x = paste("Patient", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                  y = paste("Control", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                  size = paste0("Similarity \n(1/", distance_method, ")")) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  # Return results and plots
  return(list(
    results = results,
    top_matches = top_matches,  # Filtered results with best matches only
    main_plot = p,
    grid_plot = p_grid
  ))
}
```

```{r}
strata_brain_similarity <- function(
  data,                      # Input data frame 
  brain_cols,                # Vector of column names to use for distance calculation
  group_var = "Type_hc_ms",  # Column that defines patient vs control groups
  patient_value = "MS",      # Value in group_var that identifies patients
  control_value = "HC",      # Value in group_var that identifies controls
  strat_var,                 # Stratification variable (REQUIRED - grouping for matching)
  distance_method = "euclidean", # "euclidean", "cosine", or "manhattan"
  plot_title = NULL,        # Plot title (if NULL, will be auto-generated)
  include_counts = TRUE,    # Whether to include subject counts in results
  plot_type = "heatmap"     # "heatmap" or "grid"
) {
  
  # Check if stratification variable is provided
  if (is.null(strat_var)) {
    stop("Stratification variable (strat_var) is required for strata-based matching")
  }
  
  # 1. Split data into patients and controls
  patients <- data[data[[group_var]] == patient_value, ]
  controls <- data[data[[group_var]] == control_value, ]
  
  # Remove rows with NA in any brain columns
  patients <- patients[complete.cases(patients[, brain_cols]), ]
  controls <- controls[complete.cases(controls[, brain_cols]), ]
  
  if (nrow(patients) == 0 || nrow(controls) == 0) {
    stop("No valid data after removing NA values in brain columns")
  }
  
  # 2. Get unique stratification groups and preserve ordering if factor
  is_factor_strat <- is.factor(data[[strat_var]])
  original_levels <- NULL
  
  if (is_factor_strat) {
    original_levels <- levels(data[[strat_var]])
  }
  
  patient_strata <- unique(patients[[strat_var]])
  control_strata <- unique(controls[[strat_var]])
  
  # Create cross-product of all patient and control strata combinations
  strat_combos <- expand.grid(
    patient_stratum = patient_strata,
    control_stratum = control_strata,
    stringsAsFactors = TRUE
  )
  
  # 3. Calculate mean profiles for each group
  patient_profiles <- list()
  control_profiles <- list()
  
  # Calculate patient group profiles
  for (stratum in patient_strata) {
    subset_data <- patients[patients[[strat_var]] == stratum, ]
    
    # Calculate mean for each brain column
    means <- sapply(brain_cols, function(col) mean(subset_data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE))
    
    # Count subjects in this group
    count <- nrow(subset_data)
    
    patient_profiles[[as.character(stratum)]] <- list(
      profile = means,
      count = count
    )
  }
  
  # Calculate control group profiles
  for (stratum in control_strata) {
    subset_data <- controls[controls[[strat_var]] == stratum, ]
    
    # Calculate mean for each brain column
    means <- sapply(brain_cols, function(col) mean(subset_data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE))
    
    # Count subjects in this group
    count <- nrow(subset_data)
    
    control_profiles[[as.character(stratum)]] <- list(
      profile = means,
      count = count
    )
  }
  
  # 4. Calculate distance between profiles
  calculate_distance <- function(v1, v2, method) {
    if (method == "euclidean") {
      return(sqrt(sum((v1 - v2)^2)))
    } else if (method == "cosine") {
      similarity <- sum(v1 * v2) / (sqrt(sum(v1^2)) * sqrt(sum(v2^2)))
      return(1 - similarity) # Convert to distance
    } else if (method == "manhattan") {
      return(sum(abs(v1 - v2)))
    } else {
      stop("Invalid distance method. Choose 'euclidean', 'cosine', or 'manhattan'.")
    }
  }
  
  # 5. Create results dataframe
  results_cols <- c("Patient_Stratum", "Control_Stratum", "Distance", "Similarity")
  
  if (include_counts) {
    results_cols <- c(results_cols, "Patient_Count", "Control_Count")
  }
  
  results <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = length(results_cols), nrow = nrow(strat_combos)))
  colnames(results) <- results_cols
  
  # Fill results with comparison data for all combinations
  for (i in 1:nrow(strat_combos)) {
    p_stratum <- as.character(strat_combos$patient_stratum[i])
    c_stratum <- as.character(strat_combos$control_stratum[i])
    
    # Calculate distance between mean profiles
    dist_value <- calculate_distance(
      patient_profiles[[p_stratum]]$profile, 
      control_profiles[[c_stratum]]$profile, 
      distance_method
    )
    
    # Fill row in results
    results$Patient_Stratum[i] <- p_stratum
    results$Control_Stratum[i] <- c_stratum
    results$Distance[i] <- dist_value
    results$Similarity[i] <- 1/dist_value
    
    if (include_counts) {
      results$Patient_Count[i] <- patient_profiles[[p_stratum]]$count
      results$Control_Count[i] <- control_profiles[[c_stratum]]$count
    }
  }
  
  # Ensure strata are ordered correctly if they're factors
  if (is_factor_strat && !is.null(original_levels)) {
    results$Patient_Stratum <- factor(results$Patient_Stratum, levels = original_levels)
    results$Control_Stratum <- factor(results$Control_Stratum, levels = original_levels)
  } else if (is.numeric(results$Patient_Stratum) || is.ordered(results$Patient_Stratum)) {
    results$Patient_Stratum <- factor(results$Patient_Stratum, 
                                      levels = sort(unique(results$Patient_Stratum)))
    results$Control_Stratum <- factor(results$Control_Stratum, 
                                      levels = sort(unique(results$Control_Stratum)))
  }
  
  # Create filtered results with only highest similarity for each patient group
  top_matches <- data.frame()
  
  for (p_stratum in unique(results$Patient_Stratum)) {
    # Get all rows for this patient stratum
    p_rows <- results[results$Patient_Stratum == p_stratum, ]
    
    if (nrow(p_rows) > 0) {
      # Find the row with maximum similarity
      max_row <- p_rows[which.max(p_rows$Similarity), ]
      
      # Add to top matches
      top_matches <- rbind(top_matches, max_row)
    }
  }
  
  # Preserve factor levels in top_matches
  if (is_factor_strat && !is.null(original_levels)) {
    top_matches$Patient_Stratum <- factor(top_matches$Patient_Stratum, levels = original_levels)
    top_matches$Control_Stratum <- factor(top_matches$Control_Stratum, levels = original_levels)
  }
  
  # 6. Create visualization
  # Generate plot title if not provided
  if (is.null(plot_title)) {
    cols_str <- paste(brain_cols, collapse = ", ")
    if (nchar(cols_str) > 40) {
      cols_str <- paste0(substr(cols_str, 1, 37), "...")
    }
    
    strat_name <- gsub("_", " ", strat_var)
    plot_title <- paste0("Strata-Based Brain Similarity (by ", strat_name, ")\n",
                         "Using: ", cols_str)
  }
  
  # Create appropriate visualization based on plot_type
  if (plot_type == "heatmap") {
    # Heatmap visualization (similarity between strata)
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(results, ggplot2::aes(x = Patient_Stratum, 
                                            y = Control_Stratum,
                                            fill = Similarity)) +
      ggplot2::geom_tile() +
      ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = round(Similarity, 2)), color = "black", size = 3) +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue") 
    
    # Force axis order if factor
    if (is_factor_strat && !is.null(original_levels)) {
      p <- p + 
        ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(limits = original_levels, drop = FALSE) +
        ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(limits = original_levels, drop = FALSE)
    }
    
    p <- p + 
      ggplot2::labs(title = plot_title,
                    x = paste("Patient", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                    y = paste("Control", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                    fill = paste0("Similarity \n(1/", distance_method, ")")) +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
      ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  } else if (plot_type == "grid") {
    # Grid visualization (points with size for similarity)
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(results, ggplot2::aes(x = Patient_Stratum, 
                                            y = Control_Stratum,
                                            size = Similarity)) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
      ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = round(Similarity, 2)), 
                        vjust = 2, size = 3)
    
    # Force axis order if factor
    if (is_factor_strat && !is.null(original_levels)) {
      p <- p + 
        ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(limits = original_levels, drop = FALSE) +
        ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(limits = original_levels, drop = FALSE)
    }
    
    p <- p + 
      ggplot2::labs(title = plot_title,
                    x = paste("Patient", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                    y = paste("Control", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                    size = paste0("Similarity \n(1/", distance_method, ")")) +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
      ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  } else {
    stop("Invalid plot_type. Choose 'heatmap' or 'grid'.")
  }
  
  # Create best matches grid plot
  if (nrow(top_matches) > 0) {
    p_grid <- ggplot2::ggplot(top_matches, ggplot2::aes(x = Patient_Stratum, 
                                                y = Control_Stratum,
                                                size = Similarity)) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
      ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = round(Similarity, 2)), 
                        vjust = 2, size = 3)
    
    # Force axis order if factor
    if (is_factor_strat && !is.null(original_levels)) {
      p_grid <- p_grid + 
        ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(limits = original_levels, drop = FALSE) +
        ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(limits = original_levels, drop = FALSE)
    }
    
    p_grid <- p_grid + 
      ggplot2::labs(title = paste0(plot_title, " (Best Matches Only)"),
                  x = paste("Patient", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                  y = paste("Control", gsub("_", " ", strat_var)),
                  size = paste0("Similarity \n(1/", distance_method, ")")) +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
      ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  } else {
    # Create an empty plot if no top matches exist
    p_grid <- ggplot2::ggplot() + 
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No matches found") +
      ggplot2::theme_void() +
      ggplot2::labs(title = "No matches found")
  }
  
  # Return results and plots
  return(list(
    results = results,
    top_matches = top_matches,
    main_plot = p,
    grid_plot = p_grid
  ))
}

# Example usage:

  data = plotting_subset,
  strat_var = "age_group",
  brain_cols = c("NAWM_DVR", "Brain_DVR", "Thalamus_DVR", "Cortical_GM_DVR"),
  distance_method = "euclidean",
  plot_type = "heatmap"
)

# Display plots
print(result$main_plot)  # Heatmap visualization
print(result$grid_plot)  # Grid visualization
```

**#######################################################################**
Comparisons (p-value) MS vs HC where applicable
**#######################################################################**
```{r}
data_MS <- na.omit(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]])
data_HC <- na.omit(olli_data_HC_Only[[col]])
```


```{r}
if (any(is.na(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]])) || any(is.na(olli_data_HC_Only[[col]]))) {
    cat("Skipping column:", col, "- Contains missing values\n")
    next
}

```

```{r}
data_MS <- ifelse(is.na(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]]), 
                  mean(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]], na.rm = TRUE), 
                  olli_data_MS_Only[[col]])
data_HC <- ifelse(is.na(olli_data_HC_Only[[col]]), 
                  mean(olli_data_HC_Only[[col]], na.rm = TRUE), 
                  olli_data_HC_Only[[col]])

```


```{r}
for (col in colnames(olli_data_MS_Only)) {
    if (!col %in% colnames(olli_data_HC_Only)) {
        cat("Skipping column:", col, "- Not found in both datasets\n")
        next
    }
    
    if (is.factor(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]]) || is.character(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]])) {
        
        unique_MS <- unique(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]])
        unique_HC <- unique(olli_data_HC_Only[[col]])
        
        if (length(unique_MS) < 2 || length(unique_HC) < 2) {
            cat("Skipping column:", col, "- Not enough unique values\n")
            next
        }
        

        combined_data <- data.frame(
            Group = c(rep("MS", nrow(olli_data_MS_Only)), rep("HC", nrow(olli_data_HC_Only))),
            Value = c(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]], olli_data_HC_Only[[col]])
        )
        
        contingency_table <- table(combined_data$Group, combined_data$Value)
        
        if (min(contingency_table) < 5) {
            test_result <- test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table, workspace = 2e8)

        } else {
            test_result <- chisq.test(contingency_table)
        }
        
        cat("Column:", col, "P-value:", test_result$p.value, "\n")
        
    } else if (is.numeric(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]])) {
        if (any(is.na(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]])) || any(is.na(olli_data_HC_Only[[col]]))) {
            cat("Skipping column:", col, "- Contains missing values\n")
            next
        }
        
        if (var(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0 || var(olli_data_HC_Only[[col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
            cat("Skipping column:", col, "- No variability in data\n")
            next
        }
        
        test_result <- wilcox.test(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]], olli_data_HC_Only[[col]], exact = FALSE)
        cat("Column:", col, "P-value:", test_result$p.value, "\n")
    }
}
```




```{r}
results <- data.frame(Column = character(), P_Value = numeric(), Reason = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (col in colnames(olli_data_MS_Only)) {
    if (!col %in% colnames(olli_data_HC_Only)) {
        results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Column = col, P_Value = NA, Reason = "Not found in both datasets"))
        next
    }
    
    if (is.factor(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]]) || is.character(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]])) {
        
        unique_MS <- unique(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]])
        unique_HC <- unique(olli_data_HC_Only[[col]])
        
        if (length(unique_MS) < 2 || length(unique_HC) < 2) {
            results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Column = col, P_Value = NA, Reason = "Not enough unique values"))
            next
        }
        
        combined_data <- data.frame(
            Group = c(rep("MS", nrow(olli_data_MS_Only)), rep("HC", nrow(olli_data_HC_Only))),
            Value = c(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]], olli_data_HC_Only[[col]])
        )
        
        contingency_table <- table(combined_data$Group, combined_data$Value)
        
        if (min(contingency_table) < 5) {
            test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table, workspace = 2e8)
        } else {
            test_result <- chisq.test(contingency_table)
        }
        
        results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Column = col, P_Value = test_result$p.value, Reason = ""))
        
    } else if (is.numeric(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]])) {
        if (any(is.na(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]])) || any(is.na(olli_data_HC_Only[[col]]))) {
            results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Column = col, P_Value = NA, Reason = "Contains missing values"))
            next
        }
        
        if (var(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0 || var(olli_data_HC_Only[[col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
            results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Column = col, P_Value = NA, Reason = "No variability in data"))
            next
        }
        
        test_result <- wilcox.test(olli_data_MS_Only[[col]], olli_data_HC_Only[[col]], exact = FALSE)
        results <- rbind(results, data.frame(Column = col, P_Value = test_result$p.value, Reason = ""))
    }
}

write_xlsx(results, "p_values_results.xlsx")
cat("P-values and reasons have been saved to 'p_values_results.xlsx'\n")
```

**#######################################################################**
**#######################################################################**
**#######################################################################**
**#######################################################################**
4) Group MS patients according to T1 lesion volume (high 1/3 vs low 1/3) and 
plot similar figures for brain, NAWM, WM, CGM and thalamus DVR vs age for 
three groups: HCs, low T1 and high T1 lesion load
**#######################################################################**


**Arranging T1 lesion increasingly, and divide it into three groups Low, Mid and High.**


```{r}
sorted_olli_data <- olli_data_MS %>%
  arrange(T1_hypolesion_DVR)
sorted_olli_data
```


```{r}
sorted_olli_data <- sorted_olli_data %>%
  mutate(Three_group_T1 = ntile(T1_hypolesion_DVR, 3)) %>%
  mutate(Three_group_T1 = case_when(
    Three_group_T1 == 1 ~ "Low",
    Three_group_T1 == 2 ~ "Mid",
    Three_group_T1 == 3 ~ "High"
  ))
sorted_olli_data
```




```{r}
sorted_olli_data$Three_group_T1[sorted_olli_data$Type == "HC"] <- "HC"


for (dvr_col in DVR) {
  
  plot_data <- sorted_olli_data %>%
    filter(Three_group_T1 %in% c("Low", "High") | Type == "HC") %>%
    mutate(Group = ifelse(Type == "HC", "HC", Three_group_T1)) 
  
  # Generate the plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes_string(x = "Age_at_imaging", y = dvr_col, color = "Group")) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
    labs(title = paste(dvr_col, "vs Age"), x = "Age", y = dvr_col) +
    stat_cor(method = "spearman", label.x = 20, size = 4, p.accuracy = 0.001) +  
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"), 
          axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
  
  print(p)
}

```

**#######################################################################**
**#######################################################################**
**#######################################################################**
**#######################################################################**
**#######################################################################**

**#######################################################################**
1) As for previous figure (4) but use a cut-off for T1 lesion load of 7cm3 to create 
high and low lesion load groups. Show N for groups and p-value for difference 
between groups (low, high, HC).
**#######################################################################**



```{r}
sorted_olli_data_2 <- olli_data_MS %>%
  arrange(Volume.of.all.T1.hypo.WM.lesions)
sorted_olli_data_2
```

```{r}
sorted_olli_data_2 <- sorted_olli_data_2 %>%
  mutate(Two_group_T1 = case_when(
    Volume.of.all.T1.hypo.WM.lesions <= 7 ~ "Low",
    TRUE ~ "High"
  ))
sorted_olli_data_2
```

```{r}

    filter(Two_group_T1 %in% c("Low", "High") | Type == "HC") %>%
    mutate(Group = ifelse(Type == "HC", "HC", Two_group_T1)) 
  
  # Generate the plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes_string(x = "Age_at_imaging", y = dvr_col, color = "Group")) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
    labs(title = paste(dvr_col, "vs Age"), x = "Age", y = dvr_col) +
    stat_cor(method = "spearman", label.x = 20, size = 4, p.accuracy = 0.001) +  
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"), 
          axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
  
  print(p)
}

```

**3) Similar figures for age and DTI measures in MS patients and HC as before (below)  for FA, MD, AD and RD but with three groups: MS high and low T1 lesion load  (divided both per cut-off 7cm3 and high 1/3 vs low 1/3) and HC**
***************************************************************
***************************************************************
```{r}
high_hc_data <- sorted_olli_data %>%
  filter(Three_group_T1 %in% c("High", "HC"))

low_data <- sorted_olli_data_2 %>%
  filter(Two_group_T1 == "Low")


combined_data <- bind_rows(high_hc_data, low_data)


combined_data <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(Combined_Group = ifelse(Three_group_T1 %in% c("High", "HC"), Three_group_T1, "Low"))

combined_data
```


```{r}
DTI <- c("NAWM.FA", "NAWM.MD", "NAWM.AD", "NAWM.RD")
for (dti_col in DTI) {
  p <- ggplot(combined_data, aes_string(x = "Age_at_imaging", y = dti_col, color = "Combined_Group")) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
    labs(title = paste(dti_col, "vs Age"), x = "Age", y = dti_col) +
    stat_cor(method = "spearman", label.x = 20, size = 4, p.accuracy = 0.001) +  
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"), 
          axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
  
  print(p)
}
```
```{r}
combined_data
```
